# Bread & Butter

Bread & Butter is a lead-intelligence and identity platform for managing website visitors, profiles, attribution, authentication, and conversion workflows.

Category: Marketing. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/bread-butter/.

## Actions

- **Get Application** (read-only): Return settings, feature flags, plan details, and lead-status definitions for the application bound to the connected credentials.
- **Get Attribution Report** (read-only): Return visitor and conversion attribution metrics by reporting period and source for the connected application.
- **Get User Insights** (read-only): Return aggregate attribution and user-journey insights for the connected application, with optional top-page and geography detail.
- **List Applications** (read-only): List Bread & Butter applications available to the connected credentials, optionally filtering by status or name.
- **List Event Definitions** (read-only): List configured event definitions for the connected application, optionally filtering by enabled status.
- **List Events** (read-only): List tracked activity events for the connected application, optionally scoped to a user or date range.
- **List Lead Lists** (read-only): Return the saved lead lists configured for the application bound to the connected credentials.
- **List Leads** (read-only): List lead and visitor profiles for the connected application, optionally filtering by email address.
